data.title: Electricity price increase from 1 August 2025
data.summary: Beispielstrom GmbH announces new prices for the "Beispielstrom Natur" tariff from 1 August 2025. The monthly advance payment rises from €64.00 to €71.00.
data.explanation: Your electricity provider is raising its prices because grid operators increased their fees. The unit price, base fee and monthly advance payment (Abschlag) all go up. You may accept the change, or use your special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht) without notice period, effective on the day the new prices apply. An email to the provider is enough. The app shows until when you can decide. If you want to switch, compare other tariffs first so you are not left without supply.

key_facts.quote: Wenn Sie mit der Anpassung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie Ihren Liefervertrag fristlos auf den Tag kündigen, an dem die neuen Preise gelten (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG).
